idea: Build a sheared staircase grid. Shift row i of a k×k-style grid horizontally by i·δ, which opens a staircase of left-edge gaps of widths δ, 2δ, …. Fill those gaps with squares of side iδ (or stacks of smaller ones), shrinking the row squares by LP, and enumerate k and rational δ in closed form to obtain extra counts at small sum cost.
